{{Quote|She's good with a blaster, and has little fear of danger&mdash;as long as she's properly motivated by alcohol or entertainment. I've hired her on occasion when I needed some firepower or when I knew an extra blaster wouldn't hurt. And while I can't always pay her much, Nell doesn't seem to mind as long as she can have her fun along the way.|[[Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="SL">{{JournalCite|7|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>}}
'''Nell Indigo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who frequented the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

As a child, Nell traveled with her [[Smuggler/Legends|gun-runner]] parents, learning all about the smuggling trade and making a few business contacts along the way. Since she was a member of a smuggling family, she was expected to help out in many ways like running their [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]].

When she was old enough, her parents asked her to go out on her own and make something of herself according to the traditional coming-of-age protocol for Wroonians.

Nell apprenticed herself to a Wroonian mercenary and quickly learned the ropes. When she was 20, she bought her way into the [[Guild of Glorious Mercenaries]] and used the guild connections to land several successful and adventurous jobs in the Outer Rim.
